notes.title: Game Release! - DREADTOME
notes.notes:
Those of you brave enough to venture into the corrupted archives may now prove themselves.

We've released DREADTOME's 1.0 version!



Please share your thoughts in our Steam forums, and any bugs via our in-game bug reporter.

Have fun... if you survive.
